verdict.rationale: Amplitude's core product is explicitly built around funnels, segmentation, and self-serve answers ('Build funnels, segment users, answer why') plus an AI assistant that answers plain-language questions without SQL or a data team, directly matching the founder self-serve need. Community evidence corroborates ease of adoption across non-analyst roles, though one review notes implementation/data-quality difficulties. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation specifically of funnel/drop-off analysis accuracy and ease for a non-analyst founder persona.
